title: Update ika_rwth_aachen_team membership
author: lreiher
body:
# Updates to [ika_rwth_aachen_team ](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/pull/458)membership.

Two of our ROS release repositories have just been moved to ros2-gbp, see [here](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/40024) and [here](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/40025). I'd like to add two more team members to our [new team](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/pull/458) for adding a third repository.

## New team members

* [@jpbusch](https://github.com/ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages/blob/main/etsi_its_messages/package.xml#L8)
* [@gkueppers](https://github.com/ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages/blob/main/etsi_its_messages/package.xml#L9)
